ALE-Bench-lite
	

ALE-Bench-lite dataset containing 10 selected problems: ahc008, ahc011, ahc015, ahc016, ahc024, ahc025, ahc026, ahc027, ahc039, ahc046

	
		
		Dataset Information
	

This dataset contains 10 problems from the AtCoder Heuristic Contest (AHC).

ahc008

		Usage
	

This dataset is compatible with the ALE-Bench toolkit. You can use it with:
from infiny.utils.problem_loader… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/manishs/ALE-Bench-lite.
evaluation_method: problem_score (objective value specific to each problem)
reputation: Used by researchers and practitioners working on heuristic and metaheuristic algorithms for AtCoder-style optimization problems; niche but useful for benchmarking optimization approaches.
